Saved LiDAR map from the 2026-10-04 dashboard session (map_20261004T224728) where a Go-to
relocalized 4.3 m away from the robot's true position. `scans.npz` holds D200-model scans
synthesized at the two true robot poses (map frame) from the house LiDAR-plane slice:
`goto_start_*` (where Go-to started) and `stopped_*` (where it stopped, lost), plus
`lookalike_pose`, the wrong pose the old whole-map search accepted (68 % inliers).
